instruction.text: Select the material that we get from our forests.

text: Correct! The trees in our forests are sometimes cut down for wood. This is called logging. If there is too much logging, it can threaten the forest.

instruction.text: This is the Amazon rainforest in South America. Select the dirt area to learn more.

feedback.end: A lot of the Amazon Rainforest is being cut back like this in order to make space to grow plants like soybeans. This damages the rainforest and takes away the habitat of many animals.

atoms.word: w i l d f i r e

feedback.finish: Although wildfires can be healthy, they are now happening much more often because of global warming. When they are too frequent, wildfires are a threat to the forest.

instruction.text: Decide if this is a threat to the forest or not.

feedback.wrong: Bears are a natural part of many forests.
Schools are not a threat to the forest!

feedback.end: Logging and farming can cause forests to be cut down in a non-sustainable way. Wildfires can also threaten forests when they happen too often.

feedback.finish: Power stations like this one cause nasty air pollution, but trees can help to clean the air. This means it is really important to protect our forests and grow more trees wherever possible!

instruction.text: What can we do to protect the world’s forests? Select the matching description for each image.

feedback.end: By recycling paper, fewer trees have to be cut down.
Staying on footpaths helps avoid stepping on forest life.
We can plant trees to help expand forests.

atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m7'>When do wildfires threaten the forest?</voice>

b.sound: Wildfires threaten the forest when they happen too often.
Wildfires are never a threat to the forest.

atoms.a: “Why should we stick to footpaths in the forest?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m7'>Why should we stick to footpaths in the forest?</voice>

b.sound: Sticking to the footpaths means we can avoid stepping on forest life.
There are lots of ghosts away from the footpath.

atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m7'>What can planting trees do?</voice>

b.sound: Planting trees can help expand the forest.
Planting trees means monkeys will come and visit you.
